$comment: Implements spec 03 §3 (learning areas, components, competencies and combination rules) and the canonical entity names in spec 02 §4 (learning_area.kind, component.kind, competency.kind). This file is the schema for learning-areas.json.
title: Curriculum pack learning areas (learning-areas.json)
description: Learning areas (subjects), their components, competencies and the rules that constrain learner combinations (spec 03 §3).

learning_areas.description: Every learning area the pack offers. Codes are unique within the pack (runtime check).

competencies.description: Core competencies, values, pertinent issues and attitudes reported alongside results (spec 03 §3, Appendix A). May be empty for a pack that reports only marks.

combination_rules.description: Rules that validate a learner's subject choices, for example the Kenya Senior School core set plus three pathway electives (spec 03 §3).

short_name.description: Abbreviated label for narrow report columns (spec 02 §4 learning_area.short_name).

kind.description: Learning area kind from spec 02 §4: core, optional, elective, co_curricular or pastoral.

group.description: Subject group used by aggregation constraints, for example languages, sciences or humanities (spec 03 §6 best_n groups).

coefficient.description: Subject coefficient used by weighted_mean aggregations (spec 03 §6: weighted_mean by coefficient, and Appendix J subject coefficients for the Francophone moyenne). Required by the runtime check when an aggregation weights by coefficient.

credit.description: Credit the learning area carries in a credit-weighted gpa, for example three credit hours for a major subject (spec 03 §6 gpa: credit-weighted grade points). The engine multiplies the area's grade points by it and divides by the total credit; a learning area that declares none counts as one credit.

levels.description: Levels in which the learning area is offered. Every code must be a declared level (runtime check).

national_code.description: Official subject code used by national exports, for example the KNEC code (spec 03 §3, Appendix B; spec 02 §4 learning_area.national_code). null when the system has none.

components.description: Papers, practicals, coursework, orals, projects or strands that make up the learning area score (spec 03 §4, Appendix B). May be empty.

pathways.description: Pathways this learning area belongs to, used when a combination rule says from_pathway (spec 03 §3; spec 02 §4 learning_area.pathway_ids).

alternatives.description: Learning areas that may be taken instead of this one, for example KSL in place of Kiswahili (spec 03 §3, Appendix A).

grade_scales.description: Which grade set this learning area's result uses at a set of levels, for a pack where one subject is examined on two syllabuses with different grade sets (Cambridge IGCSE A* to G and 9-1). A level not named here uses the grading scale of the scheme that covers it. At most one entry per level (runtime check).

outcomes_ref.description: Relative path, inside the pack directory, of the outcomes file this learning area's observations are recorded against, for example outcomes/eng-js.json (spec 03 §3). The path is a reference, not content: the loader validates that it is relative, ends in .json and cannot escape the pack root through a .. segment, and a pack that declares none is valid. A pack that ships the file places it beside learning-areas.json (spec 03 §2.1) and cites it here so a later outcomes import can resolve it.

kind.description: Component kind from spec 02 §4: paper, practical, coursework, oral, project or strand.

levels.description: Levels at which this component is offered. When omitted the component applies at every level the learning area is offered; declare `levels` when one subject is examined in two paper sets, for example GCSE papers at Y10-Y11 and A Level papers at Y12-Y13. Two components of one learning area may share a code only when their level sets do not overlap (runtime check): uniqueness is (learning area, level set, code).

weight.description: Share of the learning area score when component_policy is weighted. This is the fallback: a weight declared in the scheme's component_policy.weights for this learning area and component takes precedence (see assessment.schema.json). Components of one learning area must sum to 1 (runtime check; JSON Schema cannot sum).

max_score.description: Raw maximum for this paper or component. Scores are stored raw and scaled by the engine (spec 03 §4).

descriptors.description: Observable descriptors for the competency (spec 02 §4 competency.descriptors). Translated text lives in the locale files.

levels.description: Levels the rule applies to, for example G10 to G12 (spec 03 §3).

rule.description: core_all requires every listed subject (or one member of each alternative set); electives requires `count` choices, optionally from the learner's pathway, and may cap the total with `max`; group requires at least `min` and at most `max` choices from a named subject group (spec 03 §3).

of.description: Learning-area codes the rule is about. For core_all every entry is required and a pipe separates alternatives, for example KIS|KSL: at least one member must be taken. For electives it restricts the pool the count is drawn from. For group it is ignored, because the group names the pool (spec 03 §3).

count.description: Number of electives a learner must choose (spec 03 §3 example: count 3). Required by the electives rule.

max.description: Upper bound on the choices this rule counts: for electives the most a learner may take alongside the core (KCSE allows nine subjects), for group the most from the group. Must be at least `count` or `min` (runtime check).

group.description: Learning-area group the rule counts, as declared by `group` on learning areas, for example humanities. Required by the group rule; the group must declare enough learning areas at these levels to satisfy `min` (runtime check).

min.description: Least number of choices the group rule requires, for example at least one humanity. Required by the group rule.

from_pathway.description: True when the electives must come from the learner's chosen pathway (spec 03 §3).

levels.description: Levels this grade set applies to, for example Y10 and Y11 for the 9-1 syllabus.

scale.description: Grading scale code, declared in assessment.grading_scales (runtime check), for example igcse_9_1.
